decision.summary: Tenant wants to replace a broken landlord-owned LG washing machine with their own, which stays theirs. This needs landlord consent, so I asked the landlord, noted the record, told the tenant and put the job on hold to 29 July.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At intake, routine. Outstanding: landlord consent to the tenant's own machine, who pays removal and fitting, and what happens to the old machine.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Landlord approval request (APR-101) to the landlord via the agency record; the tenant has been updated by email; the job is held to 2025-07-29.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No human escalation. The decision belongs to the landlord, who has been asked.

assumptions: Tenant email thread is the channel used for intake

args.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has a power failure and says it can't be repaired (their own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent to this? Please also tell us who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to the old machine (inspect, repair or dispose). Alternatively we can send our contractor to inspect it.
options: Consent to tenant's own replacement (tenant's machine stays theirs); say who pays for removal/disposal of the old one and fitting
Send our contractor to inspect/repair the landlord's machine first

args.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current one belongs to the landlord, we need their consent before you replace it. We've passed on your offer, including that the new machine would be yours and you'd take it with you when you leave, and asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 1 August, or sooner if the landlord replies.
